students.title: Class List
students.item1: Add students: manually, via "Create Class" or CSV import.
students.item2: Select up to 3 preferred and distance partners per student – the order determines priority.
students.item3: Toggle the labels under the buttons in the student list.

layout.title: Classroom
layout.item1: Choose a template or add tables by clicking.
layout.item2: Move and rotate tables via drag & drop.
layout.item3: Multi-select: Shift or Ctrl/Cmd + click, or draw a selection rectangle.
layout.item4: Right-click (desktop) or long press (touch) opens the context menu.
layout.item5: Save custom classroom templates via the sidebar.

plan.title: Seating Plan
plan.item1: Adjust the weighting of criteria (0-10) in the sidebar.
plan.item2: Drag students to other seats via drag & drop.
plan.item3: Click the lock icon to lock a seat for the next shuffle.
plan.item4: Statistics badges show how well criteria are met.

circle.title: Seating Circle
circle.item1: Drag students to new positions via drag & drop.
circle.item2: Green lines show connections to table neighbors in the seating plan.
circle.item3: Toggle connections in the sidebar or with key C.

export.title: Export
export.item1: Customize the name of your seating plan.
export.item2: Switch between portrait and landscape format for PDF export.
export.item3: Choose between different display options like blackboard or full names.
export.item4: Toggle preview between Seating Plan and Seating Circle (top right).
